content: संदंशः .²1 A pair of tongs; अयस्मयैरग्निपिण्डैः संदंशैस्त्वचि निष्कुषन्ति <ls>Bhāg. 5. 26. 19</ls>. .²2 Too great compression of the teeth in the pronunciation of vowels (or letters). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of those parts of the body used for grasping. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a hell. .²5 A chapter or section of a book. .²6 The side of a village.
